title: Synesthete Watson who saw and felt tastes

tellings.quote: so this one guy everything that he tasted uh Wat a guy name Watson I think everything he tasted with his mouth he also uh saw things

plain: A man named Watson is said to have seen things every time he tasted something, so that a flavour came with images as well. The cognitive scientist Don Hoffman tells this to Michels from memory, unsure of the name and without giving a source, as a case of synesthesia, where the senses blend. He uses it to show that the brain can build very different pictures of the world from the same inputs.
